tableLines.line: 👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a farmer's tan (to A person, maybe 30s): "the man in his 60s, with ink-stained fingers's story has a fresh coat of paint." A man, maybe 60s, with a farmer's tan taps the table. "Scrape it off and you get from Warsaw, Poland. Just don't scrape it in front of them."
SYSTEM: Neural interface stable. Text overlay enabled.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Tariq.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 A traveler says Emberhold burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Marcus.
🧳 A traveler says Thornfield burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table II is the new fire.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Michael speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table II bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table came in the night from the southeast. They carried off ~834 kcal from the pantry. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

The little star inside Henry goes quiet — and wakes up inside Nino. Henry never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Nino will never be hungry again while it hums, and Henry is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
🥣 Victor of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.
Victor waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Stonebridge. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.
